not_seen: The new ceilings (RoofCeil), WallsUp bands and the HR office in the game: the preview build is older than those files. Ceiling and HR scores are Blender-only for those parts.
Robot dancers in my build: 'robots open' -> 'unknown command'; my 7 club shots show no robot. club_robots is scored on RENDER's 199 only (provisional).
Night in my in-game follow shots: 'time 540' did not visibly change the indoor light in showcase_v3_late; the dome did go blue. Indoor night is not judged in game.
The V-key follow path (UI card, HUD dim): I entered the follow view by debug command (fprobe), which bypasses the UI.

what_works: 15.3 satire is in every room I could see, and the best lines read at eye height: kitchen 'SPECIALS: TOFU BYTES / LATENCY LATTE / DUST CAKE', 'TODAY: ALGAE AGAIN', 'TASTE THE FUTURE*'; medical 'PLEASE WAIT: THE AI IS THINKING', 'AI-POWERED FRIDGE V2.6'; oxygen 'BREATHE IN. WE CHECKED.', whiteboard 'SPRINT 12: MAKE IT AI  DATA -> ??? -> AGI'; cantina 'LAST ORDERS: NEVER', 'ASK ME ANYTHING (I WILL TRY)'; lounge 'CHILL.EXE IS RUNNING', 'TOUCH GRASS (FAKE)'; academy planet mobile 'THE CLOUD'; mine 'WORK SMARTER / NOT HUMANER'; fabricator giant rubber duck; habitat 'SHOES OFF / ROBOTS TOO', 'HOME SWEET POD'. Original names, playful, nothing mean. Text contrast is fixed (dark ink).
Every dome room now has a ceiling at eye height (panelled liner, ribs, crown ring light, vents, pendants), so the follow view reads as an enclosed room, as Paul asked (15.5).
Role identity at eye height is clear for kitchen, cantina, lounge, greenhouse, research lab, academy, retail, park, distillery (copper stills, barrels) and the HR office.
In game (showcase_v3_late) the lounge and research lab read warm and lived-in with the game's light: r41_in_day_1, r41_in_night_0.
faults: BROKEN EVIDENCE: airlock_m_eye0..2, junction_eye0..2 and water_recycler_m_eye0..2 show only a wall or a tank face (the camera is inside geometry); storehouse_m_eye2 and cold_storage_m_eye0 put the camera inside a rack; cold_storage_m_eye2 and medical_m_eye0/1 have the stand-in inside a rack or behind a 2 m cabinet. 3 room types have no eye-height evidence at all. ART-HAB's log says 'looked at'.

RESIDENCE TUBE (family and executive L): the new ceiling liner fails under the half-tube vault - huge grey triangular shards hang from the vault into the room (residence_tube_l_eye0/1, residence_tube_executive_l_eye1/2). It reads as broken geometry.

APARTMENT BLOCK M: from floor 1 the upper floors are open from below - furniture of the floors above is visible through the slabs (apartment_block_m_eye0..2). The slab underside is missing or back-face culled.
Residences read as an office cubicle farm at eye height: 1.30 m partitions, one long view over every unit, no unit ceiling, almost no satire in the units (one 'SELECT ALL SQUARES WITH HOPE' sign).

The 17 industry types are one room with a different centre machine: the same radial 'sunburst' ceiling, the same console right of the stand-in, the same grey bench, the same wall ring, the same orange band (grp sheets of algae..titanium). The hero pieces (duck, maglev pod, tesseract, horseshoe) help but sit inside identical surroundings.

Realism at 1.8 m: every surface is a flat colour (no texture, no wear, no decal grime, no normal detail), every room has the same even white light, and big tile floors are empty (HR office L: 8 benches at random angles on an empty floor; medical, water recycler, park, oxygen plant: large bare floor). It looks like a clean blockout with jokes, not a lived-in colony.
Security office is white and grey with a thin red line; the rubric asks for black and red.
Small labels (console 'AI-ENABLED' plates, motto signs on the upper band in industry rooms) do not read at 1600x900 at this distance; they are decoration, not a cap, but the joke is lost.

what_works: Every 17.1 item is there: reception counter with stress balls, two interview rooms with tissues, the WELLBEING.AI kiosk ('1 GREAT 2 GREAT 3 OTHER*'), filing banks, the padlocked suggestion box, a ficus, 'YOUR FEELINGS ARE VALID (PENDING REVIEW)', 'SYNERGY', a 'PLEASE QUEUE (EMOTIONALLY)' floor queue with yellow rings, standing desks. S, M and L exist.
The kiosk, SYNERGY and FEELINGS pieces read at eye height (hr_office_m_eye1, hr_office_l_eye0). The tone is right: corporate wellness, playful.
Exterior: coral band and a lit roof sign 'WE ARE LISTENING*' that reads from above.
faults: The floor is mostly empty: L has 8 benches at random angles across a bare tiled floor (hr_office_l.png); it reads as furniture dropped in a hall, not an office. The interview rooms are 1.4 m booths, not rooms.
At eye height it is a generic white office; the jokes are all on the wall ring 6-10 m away. Nothing funny is near the reception or the queue except the queue rings.
The roof badge (speech bubble with a heart) reads as a '3' from above.
Not seen in game (the preview build is older than the HR files); provisional.

what_works: Airless is the strongest: black sky with stars by day, a hard white sun, black hard shadows, grey regolith (186). At eye height in the follow view it is striking (r41_out_airless_1/2).
Cold reads as cold: frost on the ground, pale sky, ice haze in the distance, blue night (183, 185, r41_out_cold_0/1).
The three planets are told apart in one glance on the 189 sheet; dry is unchanged.
faults: A yellow-green ground patch (left of the colony) glows on airless and cold, day and dusk (186, 187, 183, 184): it reads as a sickly lawn on a dead world.
Cold frost is a blotchy camouflage pattern over a pink-brown base (the dry orange desaturated shows through): 183, r41_out_cold_0.
A wind turbine stands and turns on the airless planet (186-188). SIM should refuse it there (no wind); until then it breaks the planet.
No frost on structures at night on cold (RENDER's own open item); the minimap stays orange on every planet (UI, already asked).
The mountain and mesa shapes are identical on all three planets; only the colour changes (acceptable for 5.0).

No weather inside: with 'storm 1' forced, 0 particles inside in r41_in_storm_0/1 (RENDER's weather check: 0 drawn inside).

World markers stay on in the follow view: status badges (190, 193, 194), 'WORN 80%' labels inside rooms (r41_in_day_2/3, r41_out_airless_0), and outdoor POI labels 'METEORITE FIELD / RICH DEPOSIT needs anyone' drawn through the dome walls over the mall (r41_dome_day_1..5).
190: a hard white horizontal line crosses the whole screen at 0.6 height, and the tube outside is a black void.
Framing indoors: the followed person sits in the centre and fills 40-60 % of the frame at 1.7-2.4 m (r41_in_day_1, r41_dome_day_4/5); there is no look room ahead and no depth cue.

HUD: in my (debug) follow the full HUD stays at full strength and the mission dock covers the left quarter; no follow card. UI must confirm that the V-key path dims the HUD and shows the card (15.6 centre clear).

what_works: Three robot dancers on podiums dance different moves (an arm raise, a step) between frames a and b (199).

They are clearly machines: light-bar faces, jointed chrome-black limbs, no human anatomy. Tone: PASS. The podium poles are in the contract (8, 'podiums with poles'); the framing is a performance, not sexual.
faults: The dancers are near-black silhouettes: no key light, no rim light, no spot on the podiums; the chrome does not read (199).
The floor is black, the LED tiles are blown out to white, the wall screen is a cyan noise texture with black holes, the room is empty of people.
Not in the current preview: 'robots open' -> unknown command; r41_club_a/b/c show the club black with no robots.
The camera sits behind the dancer anchors looking at the floor; there is no designed view of the stage.

what_works: A crowd reads as different people: skin tones, hair (bun with texture, short, long), outfits (white coat with blue trim, green tracksuit, black tee, the suit) (r41_in_night_0, r41_dome_day_2, 191).
Faces at 0.5 m are smooth and plausible, not uncanny (r41_in_storm_0). Walk is smooth at speed 1; feet look planted in my shots.
The suit outdoors holds at the follow distance.
faults: Arms hang straight and stiff with the hands at the thighs while walking and standing (r41_in_storm_0, r41_dome_day_4/5) - the A-pose of round 40 in a new form.
Cloth is a single glossy colour: the black tee reads as latex, the coat as plastic; no folds visible at 2 m.
Indoor people never turn to camera in the follow view, so faces are rarely seen; idle at a counter is a still back for 50 s (r41_dome_day_3..night_2).

gap_to_stunning.interiors: Now 0.64. To 0.80: textures and wear (one atlas: brushed metal, painted panel with scuffs, rubber floor, fabric; decals for grime, labels and floor paint), light per role (warm pools in the cantina and lounge, cold white in labs, amber work lights in industry, coloured neon accents), per-family ceiling and wall variants so the 17 industry rooms differ, filled floors (no empty tile fields), and the residence/apartment geometry fixed. To 0.90: hand-dressed hero corners per room (a messy desk, a half-eaten lunch, a cat bed under a console), emissive screens with animated content, glass and reflections.
gap_to_stunning.follow_view: Now 0.59. To 0.80: a framing rule (person on the left or right third, look room ahead, never a wall within 0.8 m of the lens), a clean near fade with a dither that is smoothed by TAA or an alpha fade, every world marker hidden in the follow view, the HUD dimmed with the follow card, a soft depth-of-field on the background. To 0.90: cinematic auto-shots (watch mode, 15.2).
gap_to_stunning.people: Provisional 0.63; see round 40: relaxed arms, cloth with folds and a matte fabric shader, expressions.

fixes.subject: follow_view
fixes.fix: Framing rule: the camera never faces a surface closer than 0.8 m across the centre 50 % of the frame; when it would, orbit to the free side (sample +-15..90 deg) or pull in over the shoulder; keep the person on a third (screen x 0.33 or 0.67) with look room in the walk direction. Prove it: 30 indoor follow shots on showcase_v3_late, 0 frames with the person off-screen or a wall over the centre.
